report: Source review: The complete claim requires checked expressions to represent macro expansion output and forbids a macro invocation itself from counting as a successfully checked expression node. The sole implementation association in representation_spec.rs and the sole annotated test sage_meta::todo::types_body_macro_expansion are explicitly TODO. Their comments cover both expression expansion and whole-tree rejection of unexpanded macro nodes; these are the prerequisites for substantive expansion-output and completion-validation assertions. The test body has no assertions and establishes neither requirement. Both requirements remain visibly deferred, with no ordinary implementation or behavioral coverage claimed. The captured whole file and complete test supply all context used; no helper dependency is relied upon. Baseline: independently verified exact byte equality of current representation_spec.rs against both historical implementation_sources and test_sources; reassessed the supplied historical rationale against current claim and association metadata rather than inheriting its verdict. Execution: personally ran review start and baseline comparison, and submit this report through review record; no behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 passing functional tests and cargo build are separate execution evidence and do not establish these deferred semantics. No edits requested because explicit TODO implementation and test evidence account for the complete gap.
